title: Dr.Jart+ signs Katseye’s Yoonchae Jeung as first North America Brand Ambassador

title: Mercury, lead and methanol discovered in seized counterfeit cosmetics in the UK

title: The Organic Pharmacy reacquired by founder Margo Marrone
